en.answer: Even if you do not have any cards on your field that you can place Spell Counters on, you can still activate <<14443>>. In that case, you only apply the effect that adds an "Endymion" card from your Deck to your hand.
en.question: Can I activate <<14443>> if there are no cards on my field that I can place Spell Counters on?
en.title: Can I activate <<14443>> if there are no cards on my field that I can place Spell Counters on?

ja.answer:
自分フィールドに魔力カウンターを置く事ができるカードが1枚もない場合でも、自分は「<<14443>>」を発動する事ができます。

その場合、『①：デッキから「エンディミオン」カード１枚を手札に加える』処理のみを行い、効果処理を完了する事になります。
